item.tib: mkha' 'gro dgongs pa 'dus pa las khra thel mar sa dbang sdud dang thab kha d+har sil zil gnon
item.coloph: 'di ni gcod kyi rnam 'byor pa/ rtogs ldan shes rab rkyen bskul ngor/ gsang sngags kun grol grags pa des/ ke'u tshang (tshang) nyi ma rang shar du/ mkha' 'gro dgongs 'dus zab mo yi/ dngos grub bab pa'i thun 'tshams (mtshams) su/ ma bcos glo bur thug phrad du/ brtsams pas sngags bstan rgyas gyur cig
